description:
2013 yil sentabrida Microsoft Nokia telefon biznesi va patent litsenziyasi uchun jami 5,44 milliard yevro to'lashga kelishdi: 3,79 milliard yevro telefon biznesi, 1,65 milliard yevro patent litsenziyasi uchun. 2015 yilda Microsoft bu xarid bo'yicha taxminan 7,6 milliard dollarni hisobdan chiqardi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-09: MISLEADING, fixed. The old title 'Nokia telefon biznesini 5,44 milliard yevroga sotgan' implied the phone business alone cost EUR 5.44 billion; the figure is EUR 3.79 billion for the devices and services business plus EUR 1.65 billion for a 10-year, non-exclusive patent license (Nokia kept its patents), paid in cash, announced 3 Sep 2013, closed April 2014. Title, hook, scene 1 and description now say so; scene 2 and 5 shortened to keep the scene text at 55 words. 'Nokia sold the most phones' is TRUE for about 1998-2011/early 2012 (Samsung overtook it, Gartner full-year 2011, Strategy Analytics Q1 2012), so 'bir necha yil oldin' holds. Microsoft wrote off about $7.6 billion (non-cash impairment of phone hardware assets and goodwill) on 8 Jul 2015, with 7,800 job cuts. Sources: Microsoft News Center, https://news.microsoft.com/2013/09/03/microsoft-to-acquire-nokias-devices-services-business-license-nokias-patents-and-mapping-services/ ; GSMArena, https://m.gsmarena.com/microsoft_officially_acquires_nokia_devices___services_units-news-6705.php ; Microsoft News Center, 'Microsoft announces restructuring of phone hardware business', https://news.microsoft.com/2015/07/08/microsoft-announces-restructuring-of-phone-hardware-business/ ; TechCrunch, https://techcrunch.com/2015/07/08/microsoft-writes-down-7-6b-of-its-nokia-acquisition-announces-7800-layoffs ; Datamation on Samsung ending Nokia's 14-year run, https://www.datamation.com/trends/samsung-ends-nokias-14-year-run-as-biggest-handset-maker/
